input_contract.offset_unit: Python str character index (len/slicing), NOT bytes
input_contract.hash: utf8_sha256 hashes exact UTF-8 file bytes; not an offset base

input_representation.decoded_unicode: file is the exact Unicode string the parser must receive
input_representation.raw_html_entities: file is the exact HTML fragment; do not unescape before labeling/scoring

SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE; TABLE OF CONTENTS. — Act heading chrome; amendment 2026-09-09 per Astra (frozen ignored_intervals did not cover it; prior-session chrome discussion is not a scoring rule)

scoring_rules.gold: all in-scope citations; none inside ignored_intervals
scoring_rules.fp: predictions whose span is outside ignored_intervals and not gold — not hand-picked negatives

kinds.statutory_citation: codes, session laws, Pub. L. / Public Law, CFR, short-form §
kinds.non_statutory_identifier: H.R. / similar bill numbers — gold but scored separately; does not gate statutory acceptance
kinds.bare_section_reference: gold only if anchored by § or a semantic class

scoring_rules.parser_capability: experimental — preserve actual extraction rows; EXTRACTION_FAILED is occurrence-level only

out_of_scope_references.named_acts_and_structural_refs: Named acts without locators (e.g. 'Securities Investor Protection Act of 1970') and structural references (e.g. 'title IV of the Social Security Act', 'subsection (b)') are OUT OF SCOPE: neither gold nor spurious; a parser emitting them is not penalized as FP, and a parser missing them is not penalized as miss.

taxonomy_notes_for_labeler: Session-law N Stat. P / N STAT. P are gold statutory citations.
H.R. N is gold kind non_statutory_identifier, not statute, not negative.
Longest non-overlapping spans; no nested prefixes as separate gold.
Coordinated refs are one span if that is the surface form.
